name: London Sweep Reversal
hypothesis: London open liquidity sweeps of the Asian range that close back inside tend to revert toward the opposite Asian boundary; the sweep extreme is structural invalidation.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at sweep extreme plus 0.15 M15 ATR buffer; risk constrained to 0.6-5 ATR; no broker execution
planned_rr: Structural target at opposite Asian boundary, admitted only at planned RR >= 2 (net gate intent)
known_limitations: No verified positive edge; session windows are UTC-fixed and ignore DST; CFD spread proxies; one opportunity per day; missing histories remain unresolved; tick volume is not centralized volume. Version history: 0.2.0: DST-aware London window (0.1.0 fixed UTC, one hour late in summer); sweep depth 0.05->0.10 ATR; rejection-wick confirmation added; Asian range cap 4.0->3.5 ATR.
